method.population: Every figure on this page is computed each night from the live charter offers of the {priced, number} boats based {where} that have at least one bookable 7-night charter in the next 12 months. The month tables cover charters starting from {from} to {to}.
method.median: The typical week is the median weekly price: half of the priced charter weeks cost less, half cost more. The middle half is the range between the 25th and the 75th percentile of those weeks, so the cheapest and the most expensive quarter are left out.
method.panel: Within each table the months compare like with like: they are priced over the same boats, those with a price in at least three of every four months shown. A month appears only when at least half as many boats have a price in it as in the best-covered month, so thin off-season months are left out. Weeks priced under 300 € are placeholders and never count, and figures based on fewer than 5 boats are not shown.
method.costs: Prices are for the boat per charter week, as published by our partners. A skipper, obligatory extras and the security deposit come on top. Skipper and deposit figures are medians over the boats that list them. Obligatory extras are the per-boat fees for a week; a boat without any counts as having none. Per-person items such as tourist tax are not included, and boats with a percentage-based fee (APA on crewed yachts) are left out.

hub.lede: What a yacht charter week really costs, computed every night from the live prices of {boats, number} boats. Each guide shows the typical weekly price month by month and by boat type, with skipper, extras and deposit.
hub.note: Typical week: the lowest and the highest monthly median over the next 12 months, for the boat per week. Updated {date}. Amounts in euros (EUR).
hub.read1: Prices given in the table below are for one week of charter. As shown, they include the base charge, but not any additional costs, and it is not a price per night or per person. The typical price for each month is the median, so extremely cheap/ expensive boats will not affect it too much. The prices in the tables range from the cheapest to the most expensive months in the year.
hub.read2: Additional costs to consider are: final cleaning, sheets, log book, tourist taxes, skipper (if you don't have a licence), fuel and berthing. There will also be a refundable security deposit required, which is blocked on a card during check-in. Average costs for each of these can be found in the country guides. This allows comparison of base price and total cost.

hub.saveHeading: When a charter week costs less
hub.save1: Prices depend on the time of year. Generally speaking, prices in July and August are much higher. However, in May, June, September and early October, prices for the same boat will be significantly cheaper. Weather conditions will still be reliable, and marinas will be less busy. For countries with different seasonal times, this can be seen in the monthly price table.
hub.save2: Booking early keeps the choice, booking late can lower the price. Popular models and popular times to go will be sold out many months in advance. If you book early, in Autumn/Winter, you may get early booking discounts. If some weeks are still available a few weeks before your trip, you may get very good last minute discounts. If you are flexible with your travel dates, it may be worth checking!
hub.save3: Boat type affects price. Catamarans will be more expensive than monohulls of the same length, but have more sleeping space, meaning that price per cabin may be similar. Boats 5 years old will be cheaper than new versions of the same model. Motor yachts will also mean additional fuel costs. Therefore comparing price per cabin across different types of boat is usually the fairest way to make a decision.

faq.extrasA: Most boats charge a few obligatory fees per boat and week, such as final cleaning, bed linen and the transit log, usually paid at the base.

faq.quoteQ: How do I get a yacht charter quote?
faq.quoteA: Send an inquiry from the page of any boat you like, or contact us with your dates, the country or start base, the number of guests and whether you need a skipper. A person reads every inquiry and usually replies the same working day with boats that are free on your dates and the full price: weekly rate, obligatory extras and deposit.
